subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: A framework does four things. It sets defaults (what is assumed unless overridden), changes costs (some operations become cheap, others laborious), controls visibility (what can be recorded, counted or drawn), and in social settings feeds back on the world
rationale: The report's general statement of the mechanism: defaults, costs, visibility, feedback. These are the medium's capacity / criteria / want-loop seen from inside a framework.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Claims that a framework imprisons thought do not hold up.
rationale: 5b's strong sentence ('a variant the option space cannot hold never forms') is a claim of the imprisoning kind. The report's evidence audit rejects the strong form across fields.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: the framework sets the default, and defaults drive outcomes.
rationale: A choice made once, in advance, that then steers every later choice without looking like one: the frozen-selection structure, stated for frameworks in general.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Across fields, the dependable result is a weak but measurable bias toward whatever the framework makes easy, visible or rewarded.
rationale: The weak form the note commits to: a graded bias (a price), not determinism (a wall).

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Empirical work supports *influence*, meaning faster, easier or default routes of thought. It rarely supports *determinism*.
rationale: Bounds how strongly a medium can be said to shape its users: supports the casting-director reading and cautions against the co-writer reading without direct evidence.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: What the framework cannot record drops out of reasoning.
rationale: Visibility as a bound on the option space: variants the framework cannot record are not available to be selected.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Normal science solves puzzles that the paradigm defines as legitimate, and anomalies are set aside until a crisis forces a revolution.
rationale: A paradigm acting as a criterial gate on which problems and results pass at the consensus stage.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Legibility is the mechanism through which a framework stops describing reality and starts reshaping it.
rationale: Direct statement that acting on a framework's simplification remakes the thing described.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: When people act on a framework, they can make it truer (Black-Scholes before 1987, monoculture forests "read" from tables) or break it
rationale: Use of a description changing the thing described, in both directions: the outside literature's version of the pipeline being wired into its own cargo.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: When a measure becomes the objective, effort flows to the measure rather than to what it stood for (Goodhart, Campbell, Strathern).
rationale: Target substitution is the general form of Ch 10's 'engagement is a proxy for revenue, dressed up as a proxy for user benefit'.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Leaderboard gains get read as general progress, which is a construct-validity failure.
rationale: A targeted benchmark steering what gets built and what counts as progress: objective capture at the scale of a research field.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Changes such as separators, spacing and capitalization, with no change in meaning, produced "performance differences of up to 76 accuracy points" for LLaMA-2-13B
rationale: Output hanging on the wrapper rather than the content means whoever sets the deployment format holds a large, quiet lever.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: After finding a familiar solution, players said they were searching for a better one, but their eye movements kept returning to board regions tied to the familiar solution.
rationale: Lab evidence for expert attention captured by an existing framing while the expert believes they are searching freely.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: when the familiar move was an outright blunder rather than merely suboptimal, all of the experts avoided it.
rationale: Boundary condition: expert capture holds for suboptimal framings, not for plainly wrong ones.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: number words "do not change our underlying representations of number but instead are a cognitive technology for keeping track of the cardinality of large sets across time, space, and changes in modality."
rationale: Vocabulary as a tool that extends what a mind can hold across time: evidence for the trainable-capacity side of the receiver budget.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: 72% of subjects chose the certain program when outcomes were described as lives saved, while 78% chose the risky program when the identical outcomes were described as lives lost.
rationale: Identical content decoded into different judgments depending on the frame it arrives in: the decode depends on the key, not the claim.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Single frameworks fail silently. Disagreement between several frameworks exposes the shape of each.
rationale: The report's general statement of the countermeasure.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Pre-mortems, outsider review and "consider the opposite" prompts counter Einstellung-style capture. The chess data suggest that experts are not immune and may be more confident while captured.
rationale: Deliberate out-of-framework input as the counter to expert capture: the practice versatile expertise names.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: Politically and socially charged agendas are often first presented as purely technical and they are difficult even to see.
rationale: Made categories presenting as found, technical ones: the camouflage reification describes.

subject: source:frameworks-report
quote: it "is not to make the crude claim that any arbitrary formula for option prices, if proposed by sufficiently authoritative people, could have 'made itself true' by being adopted."
rationale: MacKenzie's own limit on performativity: feedback toward the framework is constrained, not automatic.

_note: Hand extraction from the frameworks report (a markdown literature survey, so lineApprox replaces pageApprox). Quotes are the report's own words or its quotations of the works it cites; the report is a secondary source and every edge here is secondhand until those works are read directly.
